name: pdfpixels-mcp-server
title: PdfPixels PDF & Image Tools MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for PdfPixels — discover, search, and render interactive Google A2UI v1.0 surfaces for 155+ free online PDF and image processing tools (compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, sign, redact, resize).

serverInfo.name: pdfpixels-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: PdfPixels PDF & Image Tools MCP Server

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search PdfPixels PDF and image tools by keyword, file format, or category. Pass includeA2ui: true to also receive an interactive Google A2UI v1.0 surface.

query.description: Search keyword, format, or task (e.g. compress pdf, merge, ocr, heic to jpg)

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. pdf-organize, pdf-convert, image-compress)

includeA2ui.description: When true, appends an embedded application/a2ui+json v1.0 UI surface.

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Get full metadata, accepted input/output formats, processing mode, max file size, and direct URL for a PdfPixels tool by slug.

slug.description: Tool slug (e.g. compress-pdf, merge-pdf, pdf-to-word, ocr-pdf)

includeA2ui.description: When true, appends an embedded application/a2ui+json v1.0 detail card.

tools.name: recommend_workflow
tools.description: Recommend the best PdfPixels tool or multi-step workflow for a user's document or image goal (including portal upload size limits like USCIS 2MB).

task.description: Description of the user's goal (e.g. 'compress a scanned PDF under 2MB for USCIS')

includeA2ui.description: When true, appends an embedded application/a2ui+json v1.0 workflow surface.

tools.name: get_platform_limits
tools.description: Return official PdfPixels file size limits, rate limits, and zero-retention privacy guarantees.

includeA2ui.description: When true, appends an embedded application/a2ui+json v1.0 tabbed limits surface.

tools.name: render_a2ui_surface
tools.description: Generate a spec-compliant Google A2UI v1.0 Basic Catalog interactive surface for PdfPixels tool discovery, workflow recommendations, tool details, or platform limits.

intent.description: Which interactive A2UI v1.0 surface to generate.

query.description: Search query when intent is search_tools.

task.description: Task description when intent is recommend_workflow.

slug.description: Tool slug when intent is get_tool_details.
